mapper.select: select u1.U_Name as createUname, u2.U_Name as updateUname, sc.Ssc_Json as sscJson, sc.Ssc_Content as sscContent, mn.* from Sys_Message_Temp mn left join SYS_User u1 on u1.U_Id=mn.Create_Uid left join SYS_User u2 on u2.U_Id=mn.Update_Uid left join Sys_Sms_Conf sc on sc.Ssc_Temp_Code=mn.Smt_Sm_Code where mn.Smt_Code=#{code} order by mn.Create_Time Desc limit 1

select u1.U_Name as createUname, u2.U_Name as updateUname, mn.* from Sys_Message_Temp mn left join SYS_User u1 on u1.U_Id=mn.Create_Uid left join SYS_User u2 on u2.U_Id=mn.Update_Uid where mn.id=#{id}

select u1.U_Name as createUname, u2.U_Name as updateUname, mn.* from Sys_Message_Temp mn left join SYS_User u1 on u1.U_Id=mn.Create_Uid left join SYS_User u2 on u2.U_Id=mn.Update_Uid
and INSTR(mn.Smt_Name,#{params.smtName})
and INSTR(mn.Smt_Code,#{params.smtCode})
and INSTR(mn.Smt_Type,#{params.smtType})
and INSTR(mn.Smt_Content,#{params.smtContent})
and INSTR(u1.U_Name,#{params.createUname})
and INSTR(u2.U_Name,#{params.updateUname})
order by mn.${params.sortFiled} ${params.sortType}
order by ${params.sortSideFiled} ${params.sortType}
order by mn.Create_Time DESC
